job.title: Line Cook
description: The Copper Pelican is a 160-seat Gulf Coast seafood restaurant in the Warehouse District, open for dinner Tuesday–Sunday and brunch on weekends. Our pastry team bakes everything in house.
- Run your station (sauté, grill or fry) during service and keep tickets moving
- Prep your station before service to our recipes and portion standards
- Follow food safety, labeling and sanitation rules
- Work as a team with the sous chefs, expo and dish
- 1+ year of line cook experience in a high-volume, full-service kitchen
- Solid knife skills and knowledge of basic cooking techniques
- ServSafe Food Handler card (or get one within 30 days of hire)
- Able to stand for 8–10 hours, work in a hot kitchen and lift 50 lbs
$17 – $20 per hour plus a share of the tip pool. 4–5 shifts a week. Shift meal every shift.
